subject: AWS catalog launch: stakeholder onboarding & joint account plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@asterialabs.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-amt@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS catalog launch: stakeholder onboarding & joint account plan

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Asteria's pilot looks like a great fit for a catalog listing and co-sell push with AWS. To get the AWS catalog listing and joint account plan moving, can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff with your procurement lead and someone from the AWS partner team?

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Catalog listing scope + required artifacts (MAP, security questionnaire, logos) (10m)
- Joint account plan & success milestones (10m)
- Next steps: calendar invites, owners, and deadlines (5m)

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the AWS security questionnaire to this email for your review. Ben will lead the co-sell ops side; Laura can cover technical/import requirements for the listing. Karthik will coordinate the marketplace ops and billing questions.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 4/20 10:00–10:30
- Tue 4/20 14:00–14:30
- Wed 4/21 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, tell us a couple of windows and we'll adapt. Also, please flag any mandatory stakeholders we should invite from your org (procurement, security, Solutions Architect).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (attachment: 76 KB), aws_security_questionnaire.pdf (attachment: 120 KB)

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@asterialabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS catalog launch: stakeholder onboarding & joint account plan

Monica —

Thanks, this looks good. I can do Tue 4/20 14:00–14:30 PDT. I'll invite our procurement manager (Daniel Kim) and our Head of IT (Sara Patel). Also looping in our AWS partner lead at the address you included. 

A couple of quick items from our side:
- Procurement will want an estimated monthly spend and a draft order form before they commit to the timeline. Do you have a short cost estimate we can share?
- Our security reviewer may push for SOC 2 artifacts; do you have a point of contact for that?

I'll send the invite once we lock the time. Forwarding the MAP to procurement now for a first read.

Best,
Emily Jones
Director of Partnerships, Asteria Labs
emily.jones@asterialabs.com

Hi Emily —

Thanks for confirming 4/20 14:00 PDT. We'll plan for a 30-minute sync and aim to walk through a lightweight demo of the pilot flow (5–7 minutes) so procurement has context on usage and expected spend. Laura, can you cover the demo outline (high level) and any technical prerequisites?

Couple notes for procurement: we can provide a conservative monthly estimate based on projected token usage and instance mix; I can send a one-page estimate before the meeting. We also have a SOC 2 summary and an audit contact for detailed evidence requests — attaching the security questionnaire responses and a pointer to our SOC 2 summary page in the drive.

Attaching an updated MAP with milestones and owners (small edits).

—Ben
